<div class="card-body">
'''Jedi Presence''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジェダイの気配</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘に自分のジェダイが参加している時に使う。1フォース消費して、すべての反乱軍の戦闘力を2倍にする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-92o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジェダイ・ナイトが姿を見せれば、戦場での味方の士気があがる。オビ＝ワンによって反乱軍は勇気づけられ、デス・スターを脱出することができた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jedi Presence.

'''Card text:''' Use when one of your Jedi is in a battle. Use 1 Force to double the power of all Rebels.

'''Lore:''' When a Jedi Knight appears, allies on the battlefield take heart. Obi-Wan encouraged the Rebels and they escaped the Death Star.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese doubles all Rebel power; the English doubles all other Rebels there.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Jedi Presence]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
